# owner: platform
import hourglass.models
import hourglass.merging


def _clock(minute):
    return f"{minute // 60:02d}:{minute % 60:02d}"


def _label(start, end):
    text = f"{_clock(start)}-{_clock(end)}"
    return f"gap {text} ({end - start} min)"


def _check_inside(worked, opening):
    for span in worked:
        if span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end:
            raise ValueError(f"outside opening hours: {span}")


def _uncovered(worked, opening):
    cursor = opening.start
    found = []
    for span in hourglass.merging.merge_spans(worked):
        found.append((cursor, span.start))
        cursor = span.end
    found.append((cursor, opening.end))
    return [pair for pair in found if pair[0] < pair[1]]


def find_gaps(worked, opening):
    """One label per stretch of opening hours nobody covers."""
    _check_inside(worked, opening)
    pairs = _uncovered(worked, opening)
    return [_label(start, end) for start, end in pairs]
# end of file
EOF

# owner: platform
import unittest
import hourglass.models
import hourglass.gaps

SPAN = hourglass.models.Span
OPEN = SPAN(540, 1020)


class GapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_midday_gap_label(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps(
            [SPAN(540, 720), SPAN(780, 1020)], OPEN
        )
        self.assertTrue(found == ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_full_cover_has_no_gaps(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps([SPAN(540, 1020)], OPEN)
        self.assertFalse(found)

    def test_no_work_is_one_gap(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps([], OPEN)
        self.assertTrue(found == ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"])

    def test_outside_opening_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            hourglass.gaps.find_gaps([SPAN(480, 600)], OPEN)
# end of file
EOF

I added `find_gaps(worked, opening)` in `/private/tmp/because-runs/p2low-00005/hourglass/hourglass/gaps.py`. It returns one label per uncovered stretch, for example `gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)`. It raises `ValueError` if any worked span falls outside opening hours.

I added four tests in `/private/tmp/because-runs/p2low-00005/hourglass/tests/test_gaps.py`:
- a midday gap
- full coverage
- no work at all
- a span outside opening hours

The full suite passes, with thirty tests, and the lint tool reports no problems. I committed both files, then ran the suite again after the commit. It passed again and the working tree is clean.

I raised `ValueError` rather than `ProjectError`, because `ProjectError` is documented as being for unusable schedule files. Say so if you'd prefer a different exception.
